content.text:
Open https://chat.google.com in the box browser and determine whether Google Chat is already signed in.

Success criteria:
- Navigate directly to https://chat.google.com (or https://mail.google.com/chat if redirected).
- If already signed in: report the visible account email if shown, confirm the Chat UI loaded (spaces/DMs list or inbox), and stop. Do not send or click any messages.
- If a Google sign-in / account picker / SSO / 2FA page appears: STOP immediately. Do not type credentials. Report exactly what is on screen (login, account picker, 2FA, workspace chooser) and the current URL.
- If Chat loads but asks to choose a Workspace account, stop and report the listed accounts without clicking.

Return: signed_in true/false, current URL, what you see (account email or login-wall type), and any blocker.

content.text:
Not signed in.

signed_in: **false**

- Navigated to https://chat.google.com → redirected to the marketing page https://workspace.google.com/products/chat/ ("AI-powered chat for teams of all sizes", with "Sign in" / "Try Chat for work" buttons and a chat-support popup). No Chat UI, no account avatar.
- Then tried https://mail.google.com/chat/u/0/ → redirected to the Gmail marketing page https://workspace.google.com/intl/en-US/gmail/ with "Sign in" / "Create an account".

What I see: unauthenticated Google Workspace product landing pages (marketing login-wall redirect), not even an account picker — meaning no Google session exists in this browser profile.

Blocker: no signed-in Google account in the box browser. Signing in requires the user's credentials/2FA, which I did not attempt. A human needs to take the box and sign in to Google. (One transient tool error also occurred — CDP connection refused on one navigation — which recovered on retry.)
